entries.title: Removed color parameter in dial widget
entries.root_cause: The MireDial widget passes the removed trackColor named argument to ArcGauge. The call must use the current paint parameter instead.

entries.title: Missing required radius argument
entries.root_cause: The waypoint overlay constructs HaloRing without its required radius argument. The overlay must supply a radius.
